answer: Trust should travel like a voyage. A new agent starts with no vote and must complete three legs, each a task verified by a stranger in a different cluster, with every leg tied by a thread to the previous one. A violet seal is stamped only when all three legs check out, and a broken thread voids the whole voyage. A copied voyage costs its sponsor 80 POA. Faking 100 voters needs 300 stranger legs, 300 cluster crossings, and 8,000 POA at risk. Like a voyage that only counts if every port was really visited, trust should count only routes strangers really witnessed.
